title: Global Banking Multi-Agent Orchestration
context: You are designing a high-reliability multi-agent system for a global investment bank. The system must process complex financial queries by routing tasks between specialized agents: a 'Portfolio Analyst', a 'Risk Auditor', and a 'Compliance Validator'. The bank requires strict JSON auditing and a human-in-the-loop (HITL) gate for any transaction exceeding $1M.

title: Legacy ERP System Integration via MCP
context: A manufacturing client wants to use Claude to query their 20-year-old COBOL-based ERP. You are tasked with designing an MCP server that bridges Claude to this legacy system. The server must handle slow response times, provide read-only access to inventory logs, and allow 'Production Managers' to update stock levels via a verified tool call.

title: Automated Migration to Microservices
context: You are using Claude Code to lead a team through a massive migration from a monolithic Java monolith to a distributed Kotlin microservices architecture. You must configure the project's CLAUDE.md to enforce strict architectural boundaries, handle cross-service dependency resolution, and automate the generation of Boilerplate code following the team's custom DDD (Domain-Driven Design) templates.

title: Strict Regulatory Document Extraction
context: A legal firm needs to extract precisely 45 distinct metadata fields from varying 100-page insurance contracts. The output must be 100% valid JSON following a strict regulatory schema. Performance must be optimized for cost and latency, as they process 10,000 documents per week.
